```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(vpfkit)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
tse <- readRDS(params$tse_path)
```

## Dataset Summary

```{r summary}
n_contigs <- nrow(tse)
n_samples <- ncol(tse)
assay_names <- paste(assayNames(tse), collapse = ", ")
cat(sprintf("- **Contigs**: %d\n", n_contigs))
cat(sprintf("- **Samples**: %d\n", n_samples))
cat(sprintf("- **Assays**: %s\n", assay_names))

rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(tse))
if ("checkv_contig_length" %in% colnames(rd)) {
  cat(sprintf("- **Total contig length**: %s bp\n", format(sum(rd$checkv_contig_length, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
  cat(sprintf("- **Median contig length**: %s bp\n", format(median(rd$checkv_contig_length, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")))
}
```

## CheckV Quality Distribution

```{r checkv-quality, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
rd <- as.data.frame(rowData(tse))
if ("checkv_quality" %in% colnames(rd)) {
  quality_counts <- as.data.frame(table(rd$checkv_quality, useNA = "ifany"))
  colnames(quality_counts) <- c("Quality", "Count")
  ggplot(quality_counts, aes(x = Quality, y = Count, fill = Quality)) +
    geom_col() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "CheckV Quality Distribution", x = NULL, y = "Number of contigs") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
} else {
  cat("CheckV quality data not available.")
}
```

```{r checkv-length, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
if (all(c("checkv_contig_length", "checkv_quality") %in% colnames(rd))) {
  ggplot(rd, aes(x = checkv_contig_length, fill = checkv_quality)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8, bins = 50) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Contig Length Distribution by Quality", x = "Contig length (bp, log10)", y = "Count")
}
```

## Completeness

```{r completeness, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
if ("checkv_completeness" %in% colnames(rd)) {
  ggplot(rd, aes(x = checkv_completeness, fill = checkv_quality)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8, bins = 50) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Genome Completeness Distribution", x = "Completeness (%)", y = "Count")
}
```

## Taxonomy Composition

```{r taxonomy, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if ("Family" %in% colnames(rd)) {
  family_counts <- as.data.frame(table(rd$Family, useNA = "ifany"))
  colnames(family_counts) <- c("Family", "Count")
  family_counts <- family_counts[order(-family_counts$Count), ]
  family_counts <- head(family_counts, 20)
  ggplot(family_counts, aes(x = reorder(Family, Count), y = Count)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4ECDC4") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Viral Families", x = NULL, y = "Number of contigs")
} else {
  cat("Taxonomy data not available.")
}
```

## Alpha Diversity

```{r alpha-diversity, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
if (requireNamespace("mia", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tse_div <- mia::estimateDiversity(tse, assay.type = "counts", index = "shannon", name = "Shannon")
  cd <- as.data.frame(colData(tse_div))
  cd$Sample <- rownames(cd)
  ggplot(cd, aes(x = Sample, y = Shannon)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2196F3") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Shannon Diversity per Sample", y = "Shannon Index") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

## Abundance Overview

```{r abundance-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
mat <- assay(tse, "counts")
top_n <- min(30, nrow(mat))
top_idx <- order(rowMeans(mat), decreasing = TRUE)[1:top_n]
mat_top <- mat[top_idx, , drop = FALSE]
# Simple heatmap using base R image
heatmap(as.matrix(mat_top), scale = "row", main = "Top 30 Contigs by Abundance (row-scaled)",
        margins = c(8, 12), cexCol = 0.8, cexRow = 0.6)
```

## Gene Annotations

```{r gene-annotations}
ga <- S4Vectors::metadata(tse)$gene_annotations
if (!is.null(ga) && nrow(ga) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("- **Total genes annotated**: %d\n", nrow(ga)))
  if ("dramv_category" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    cat(sprintf("- **AMG genes**: %d\n", sum(ga$dramv_category == "AMG", na.rm = TRUE)))
    cat(sprintf("- **Viral genes**: %d\n", sum(ga$dramv_category == "viral", na.rm = TRUE)))
  }
  if ("pharokka_card" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    n_card <- sum(!is.na(ga$pharokka_card) & ga$pharokka_card != "NA")
    cat(sprintf("- **CARD hits (antibiotic resistance)**: %d\n", n_card))
  }
  if ("pharokka_vfdb" %in% colnames(ga)) {
    n_vfdb <- sum(!is.na(ga$pharokka_vfdb) & ga$pharokka_vfdb != "NA")
    cat(sprintf("- **VFDB hits (virulence factors)**: %d\n", n_vfdb))
  }
} else {
  cat("No gene annotations available.")
}
```
